## Surviving Transylvania situation report

**Sources on this page:** p129 A7, p129 A8.

**Related source pages:** [p128 B1](128.md#source-p128-b1), [p137 A4](137.md#source-p137-a4), [p137 A5](137.md#source-p137-a5).

<a id="edition-cases-military-transylvania-situation-report-surviving-transylvania-situation-report"></a>



Prepared by **icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro**.

This is a proposed cross-page assembly of an eight-part message marked 1840 / 18.40, 8 TLE, LP v NKJ. Parts 1, 7 and 8 survive on pp128–129; p137 supplies part 4 and conditional partial readings of interference-damaged parts 5 and 6. Parts 2 and 3 remain unlocated. All uses of the Nov4–6 key retain its published square and ranks.

The headings conflict: pp128–129 say 5 November with different evening receipt times; p137 has a 6 November page heading and 08.14 on 5 November in its receipt line, alongside the 18.40 origin. Matching headers, part numbers and content support the association but do not resolve those dates or prove an exact transmission history.

<a id="edition-cases-military-transylvania-situation-report-missing-and-unread-material"></a>

### Missing and unread material

The p128 copy explicitly states that parts 2–6 are missing. The separate p137 page supplies independent surviving material for 4–6. It does not restore parts 2/3, and part 6 has no stated length. A [separate conditional A6 edition](137.md#edition-cases-military-p137-publicity-fragment) proposes 25 letters in a 254-slot frame, preserving 102 unknown positions and the equally compatible 256/258-slot alternatives. Its polarity and intervening verb remain unread.

<a id="edition-cases-military-transylvania-situation-report-evidence-and-totals"></a>

### Evidence and totals

The five readable physical sources provide 550 modeled plaintext positions: 499 fixed under their declared raw geometries and 530 after the stated candidates. Costs are six observed-coordinate substitutions, seven fills of printed dashes/invalid glyphs, and 24 missing-coordinate fills. The 74-slot part 6 now has its own [25-letter conditional catalogue entry](137.md#edition-cases-military-p137-publicity-fragment); it remains excluded from these five-source totals. That separate model has zero raw fixed positions and does not establish the missing sentence.

The earlier corpus screen already recognized parts 1/7/8. Lasry et al. describe a different thirteen-part report of 3 November in their Table 3; this edition makes no first historical decipherment claim. A complete 788-block exact-window search found only one short 12-coordinate incidental lead and no missing part 2/3.

### p137 A5

The conditional complete reading orders the removal of economic and
administrative staffs before military movements begin:

**Readable German — conditional complete part-5 proposal:**

> Anschliessend muessen vor Beginn militaerischer Bewegungen Personal der
> Wirtschafts- und Verwaltungsstaebe ab 6. November abgeschoben werden.

The proposal reaches **126/126 positions**, including two separately priced
`X` separators after `WIRTSCHAFTS` and `WERDEN`. Each separator supplies one
missing coordinate while retaining its observed half. The full part costs
**seven observed substitutions, four printed-mask fills and 37 missing-coordinate
fills** under the earlier conditional 0/37 interference frame. The source-68
V alternative lowers the substitution total to six. The literal `MUESSEN`
and date label `6` are retained.

The [completion account](../experiments/p137_governing_clause/README.md#completing-the-two-separators)
shows all 36 possible residual label pairs before the punctuation choice.
This completes the proposed reading of part 5; the missing parts and the
separate part-6 fragment remain as described above.

Printed 215 / advertised 252 means 37 missing coordinates in addition to four printed dashes. All 38 allocations between the two explicit INTERFERENCE locations are retained. The 0/37 model is the unique zero-observed-error fit for the explicit 20-character prefix ANSCHLIESSENDMUESSEN; this remains conditional on that crib. Four compatible word spans fill 21 erased coordinates without changing any observed coordinate. Twenty plaintext positions and the awkward observed middle wording remain unresolved. This is a partial reading, not a completed sentence.

A [separate staff-vocabulary proposal](../experiments/p137_optional_staff_vocabulary/README.md)
reads `WIRTSCHAFTS?UNDVERWALTUNGSSTAEBE` under the same conditional 0/37 frame.
It adds three observed-coordinate substitutions and ten missing-coordinate

price remain unchanged. Independent witnesses attest the two staff compounds,
not this complete clause or its historical execution.

The [governing-clause supplement](../experiments/p137_governing_clause/README.md)

<a id="edition-cases-finance-military-allowances"></a>

## p129 B1 — Meal allowances judged excessive and Swedish rates rejected as a standard

**Edition context:** Meal allowances, communal provisioning and a refused supplement.

**Related source pages:** [p133 A2](133.md#source-p133-a2), [p133 A3](133.md#source-p133-a3), [p134 A4](134.md#source-p134-a4).

<a id="edition-cases-finance-military-allowances-meal-allowances-communal-provisioning-and-a-refused-supplement"></a>



**Source:** J. Rives Childs, *General Solution of the ADFGVX Cipher System*,
printed p129 B1, p133 A2–A3 and p134 A4; PDF page 132, 136 and 137.
**Edition:** icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro.

These four numbered parts form one message. The repeated receipt header
is `NKJ FUER COS v LP (7.18 a.m., November 6th)`, and the origin line is
`2400 (5/11) 4 TEILE`. The pages carry the heading 5 November 1918 and
explicit continuation annotations. The matching headers and numbers
provide the cross-page link despite the intervening pages of other
traffic.

The message disputes high cash meal allowances, requires rates to be
reduced, promotes communal purchasing and provision of food in kind,
and refuses an application for a cost-of-living supplement. It supplies
no actual allowance rate. The [experiment](../experiments/military_allowances/README.md)
contains every source crop, coordinate and candidate edit.

<a id="edition-cases-finance-military-allowances-attribution-counts-and-verification"></a>

### Attribution, counts and verification

The period key is previously published. Parts one, two and four also
predate this edition as readable unreviewed repository candidates.
Part three was unreadable under its earlier OCR frame; the old outputs
are frozen alongside the corrected source edition. The contribution
here is complete source assembly, recovery of that direct reading and
reversible candidate repairs. The bounded paper, dissertation and
comment-thread check does not establish historical decipherment priority.

The four records contain **1,760 printed source slots**, of which
**1,757** are valid ADFGVX coordinates. They yield **880 plaintext
positions**: 877 fixed in the raw models and all 880 in the explicit
candidates. Total cost is **10 observed substitutions and three printed
erasure fills**, with no key, rank or length changes. These counts describe
the edition's coverage, not the number of newly solved key symbols.

```bash
python experiments/military_allowances/verify.py --verify
python experiments/military_allowances/verify.py --verify --pdf /path/to/childs.pdf
```

482-slot stream. Correcting the transcription produces the following

NATURALVERPFLEGUNGMUSSREGELBILDENXDIESEDURCHGEMEINSAMENEINKAUFXUMPREISENICHTUNNOETIGINHOEHEZUTREIBENUNDDURCHEINRICHTUNGDEUTSCHERSPEISEHAEUSERNACHMOEGLICHKEITFOERDERNSODASSSELBSTVERPFLEGUNGAUFTATSAECHLICHNICHTZUUMGEHENDEFAELLEBESCHRAENKTBLEIBTX

Every plaintext pair is complete. **No source coordinate is changed or

the unchanged Nov4–6 key.

**Readable German:**

> Naturalverpflegung muss Regel bilden. Diese durch gemeinsamen Einkauf, um Preise nicht unnötig in Höhe zu treiben, und durch Einrichtung deutscher Speisehäuser nach Möglichkeit fördern, sodass Selbstverpflegung auf tatsächlich nicht zu umgehende Fälle beschränkt bleibt.

The passage calls for communal purchasing to avoid unnecessary price
increases and for German dining facilities to reduce reliance on cash
self-provisioning. It does not state that such facilities had already
been established.
